content:
Maya (AE): Quick help pls — CrescentCare wants a 2-week POC next week. Start on Hosted API, potential move to Dedicated/Private. They say they have a custom model 'arcadia-llama-70b-finetuned-v2' (fp16). Needs streaming + kv-cache, target p50 <200ms, ~500 reqs/min steady (bursts to 800), avg 1.5k tokens. Also asked for security questionnaire answers by EOD Fri. Any immediate blockers?

Raj (SE): Do we have that artifact in our catalog? Name doesn't match our verified entries. Need HF or S3 artifact URL + model.config.json and tokenizer files. Also want to know which attention kernel and RMSNorm op versions they used — that affects kernel selection.

Oliver (Solutions Eng): We ran a similar arcadia fork in lab last month; it used FlashAttn2 + a custom RMSNorm patch. Hosted should work for a smoke, but Dedicated cost will be significant unless they accept a quantized variant (q4_0 / q8_0). Need to confirm quality tolerance.

Emily (SalesOps): PricingBot, ballpark hosted vs dedicated delta for 70B fp16 vs q4_0 for a 2-week POC with those traffic numbers?

PricingBot: Hosted estimate (70B fp16): high per-token cost; q4_0 reduces token compute ~3x. Dedicated reserved (trial) adds GPU-hour invoiceable minimum; for burst capacity factor 2x hardware sizing. I'll DM Emily a more precise calc. :money_with_wings:

Lina (Product): Product notes: 1) Streaming + function-calling rely on tokenizer chunking — ensure tokenizer matches adapter else streaming breaks. 2) KV-cache correctness: if they modified attention masks/cross-attention semantics the cache can misbehave. Recommend a small multi-turn smoke test that exercises 5k token history.

Zoe (Security): We can prefill the questionnaire. Need answers: customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP/HSM?), data residency (EU/US), retention policy for PII, and required compliance (SOC2/HIPAA). Hosted supports AWS KMS envelope today; GCP/HSM needs extra work — Private required for full HSM attestation.

Maya (AE): I'll ask CrescentCare to provide: HF/S3 model link, model.config.json, tokenizer files, a 5-multi-turn prompt set for eval, KMS preference, and traffic profile (burst pattern). Also ask if they accept q4_0 variant for latency/cost tradeoff.

Raj (SE): Onboarding steps from eng: 1) compatibility scan (tokenizer match, custom ops) 2) build quantized candidate (q4_0) + regression eval 3) smoke load test with KV cache and 5k token history 4) enable streaming + function-call demo. If artifacts arrive today, we can spin a smoke instance in ~48h.

Oliver (Solutions Eng): Provide this short local harness to validate tokenization before handing model to us — helps catch tokenizer drift:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"arcadia-llama-70b-finetuned-v2","input":"<EOD> Hello\nHow are you?\nDraft a 3-line summary of the chat."}'
```
If the output tokens look off, ask them to send tokenizer files or a tokenizer adapter.

Zoe (Security): Quick flag: they request customer-accessible audit logs for model weights retrieval and MFA logs for privileged users. We can supply robust audit trails for Dedicated/Private; Hosted provides standard access logs but not customer-managed HSM attestations. Mark as potential blocker for Hosted if they insist on HSM-level controls.

Maya (AE): CrescentCare also asked about contractual SLA for latency during POC. Who can share standard POC SLA blurb?

Emily (SalesOps): Typical POC SLA (short): "POC engagements are provided on a best-effort basis with operational support and monitoring. Enterprise SLAs apply to Dedicated/Private agreements; Hosted trial usage does not include guaranteed latency/uptime."

Raj (SE): On the p50 <200ms target: with avg 1.5k tokens on a 70B fp16 model that's aggressive on Hosted. Quantized q4_0 on high-end GPUs or Dedicated instances tuned for latency may approach 200-300ms p50. To reliably get under 200ms we'd want shorter average tokens or beefier GPU class. Set expectation now. :warning:

Maya (AE): I'll align with the prospect. If they send model+answers by 4pm we can start the 48h smoke path.

Oliver (Solutions Eng): deploy-bot has queued an ephemeral smoke instance (arcadia-70b-candidate) — ETA ~45m. I'll run the compatibility scan once it's up. Maya, paste eval prompts here and I'll kick off automated regressions.

Maya (AE): Thanks all — I'll chase CrescentCare for artifacts and update this thread. If we get the model by 4pm we proceed with the 48h smoke. :thumbsup:
